# Brand Vitals

> Brand Vitals is a marketing agency based in New Cairo, Egypt, working with brands in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. It connects brand strategy, creative production, websites and performance marketing into one system measured on business results (revenue, orders, qualified leads), not reach. Founded by Mohamed Ahmed (Co-founder, Growth & Strategy) and Mohamed Tarek (Co-founder, Creative & Production).

Contact: info@brandvitals.io · WhatsApp +20 109 086 1397 · Sunday to Thursday, 10:00 to 18:00 (Cairo). Work is delivered in Arabic and English; meetings for Saudi clients run on Riyadh time and invoices can be issued in SAR.

## Services
- [Performance marketing](https://brandvitals.io/performance-marketing.html): Meta, TikTok and Snapchat campaigns with creative testing and weekly optimisation.
- [Google Ads](https://brandvitals.io/google-ads.html): Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube in Arabic and English.
- [SEO and Arabic SEO](https://brandvitals.io/seo.html): technical SEO, bilingual architecture and Arabic content.
- [Brand and creative](https://brandvitals.io/branding.html): positioning, identity and campaign creative.
- [Websites and CRO](https://brandvitals.io/web-cro.html): conversion-focused sites and landing pages.
- [Analytics and tracking](https://brandvitals.io/analytics-tracking.html): GA4, Tag Manager, Conversions API, server-side tracking.
- [How pricing works](https://brandvitals.io/products.html): no fixed packages; every engagement is scoped and priced by proposal. VAT applies (14% Egypt, 15% Saudi Arabia).

## The Brand Vitals family
- [Vitals Frames](https://brandvitals.io/frames.html): production studio for ads, reels, films and photography built to be tested.
- [Vitals Web](https://brandvitals.io/web.html): Arabic and English websites on fixed packages and timelines.
- [Vitals Stage](https://brandvitals.io/stage.html): conferences, launches and exhibitions with one accountable team.
- [Vitals GO](https://brandvitals.io/go.html): software for agencies: send work on one link, get client approvals on any channel, bill extra work.
- [Vitals Crew](https://brandvitals.io/crew.html): vetted freelancers and creative teams; every delivery is reviewed by Brand Vitals.
- [Vitals Hire](https://brandvitals.io/hire.html): hiring platform for creative and marketing jobs; every application is screened by Brand Vitals before a company sees it.
